target.role: Associate Director Senior Business Analyst Capital Markets

summary: Associate Director, Senior Business Analyst (Capital Markets) candidate with ~7 years of business analysis experience bridging institutional stakeholders and data/engineering teams across ALM, risk analytics, and financial platforms. Translates complex, ambiguous Capital Markets data requirements into precise data specifications and validated analytics, holding delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement). Advanced SQL and Python; CFA plus dual MSc. Proven at influencing senior stakeholders and driving Agile delivery.

sections.heading: Requirements, Data Specifications & Stakeholder Delivery
bullets: Translated complex, ambiguous institutional data requirements into precise data specifications and functional models for multi-asset analytics delivered to pension funds, asset managers, and insurers ($5-25bn per engagement; ~$50bn+ cumulative).

Prepared and presented analytical summaries to senior stakeholders and clients' Heads of Risk on rate exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities - securing acceptance and translating quantitative outputs into decision-ready narratives.
Served as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues across the product lifecycle, from design and development through implementation and production monitoring.

sections.heading: Data Governance, Validation & Metrics
bullets: Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs - independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Member of the model governance committee - contributed to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and validation protocols for client-delivered analytics.

Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics and return calculations feeding downstream reporting; validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation.
Owned reference-data and assumption validation, escalating outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility to establish data-quality and validation standards.

sections.heading: Data Engineering, SQL & Agile Delivery
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python and SQL analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls (PostgreSQL day-to-day).
Led design and delivery of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection and time-bucketed gap engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across analytical horizons.

Built agentic-AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection - reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM analytics platforms.
Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and Product Owners - scoping requirements into structured development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 data-and-technology transformation projects for insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness processes.

Delivered ALM and risk studies for pension funds and institutional investors - analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet exposures, and presenting findings to investment committees on-site.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and attribution to test allocation robustness.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing rate risk and funding volatility across base-case and stressed environments.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
